description: Defines the class interface for Metal Surface rendering in ANGLE project, including class SurfaceMtl with methods for surface management, rendering, and texture handling using Metal API.

classes.name: SurfaceMtl
classes.description: Class managing Metal surface rendering, including surface initialization, buffer swapping, texture binding, and resizing.

methods.name: SurfaceMtl
methods.description: Constructor initializing the Metal surface with display, window, and attributes.

methods.name: ~SurfaceMtl
methods.description: Destructor for cleaning up resources.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Destroys the surface resources.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the surface with display parameters.

methods.name: createDefaultFramebuffer
methods.description: Creates the default framebuffer for rendering.

methods.name: makeCurrent
methods.description: Makes the surface current for rendering.

methods.name: unMakeCurrent
methods.description: Releases the current surface.

methods.name: swap
methods.description: Swaps the buffers for display.

methods.name: postSubBuffer
methods.description: Posts a sub-region of the buffer.

methods.name: querySurfacePointerANGLE
methods.description: Queries surface pointer attributes.

methods.name: bindTexImage
methods.description: Binds a texture image to the surface.

methods.name: releaseTexImage
methods.description: Releases the bound texture image.

methods.name: getSyncValues
methods.description: Retrieves synchronization values.

methods.name: setSwapInterval
methods.description: Sets the swap interval.

methods.name: setFixedWidth
methods.description: Sets fixed width for the surface.

methods.name: setFixedHeight
methods.description: Sets fixed height for the surface.

methods.name: getWidth
methods.description: Returns current width of the surface.

methods.name: getHeight
methods.description: Returns current height of the surface.

methods.name: isPostSubBufferSupported
methods.description: Checks if post sub-buffer is supported.

methods.name: getSwapBehavior
methods.description: Returns swap behavior.

methods.name: getAttachmentRenderTarget
methods.description: Retrieves the render target attachment.

methods.name: swapImpl
methods.description: Implementation detail for buffer swapping.

methods.name: ensureRenderTargetsCreated
methods.description: Ensures render targets are created.

methods.name: obtainNextDrawable
methods.description: Obtains the next drawable for rendering.

methods.name: ensureDepthStencilSizeCorrect
methods.description: Ensures depth/stencil size matches requirements.

methods.name: checkIfLayerResized
methods.description: Checks if the Metal layer has been resized.
